blocks.html: The data to manage product options of a product.

types.name: LinkProductOptionsToProductWorkflowInput
types.description: The data to manage product options of a product.

children.name: product_id
children.description: The ID of the product to manage its options.

children.name: add
children.description:
The product options to add to the product. You can pass one of the
following:

1. The ID of an existing product option as a string.
2. An object with `id` and `value_ids` to add an existing product option with specific values. This
is useful when you want to associate only specific option values of an option to the product.
3. An object to create a new product option.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the product option to add.

children.name: value_ids
children.description: The IDs of the product option values to associate with the product option.

children.name: ranks
children.description: The rank for each option value. The key is the option value, and the value is the rank.

children.name: is_exclusive
children.description: Whether the product option is exclusive to a product or shared across products.

children.name: metadata
children.description: The metadata of the product option.

children.name: remove
children.description: The product options to remove from the product.

children.name: update
children.description: The product option values to update for existing product options.

children.name: product_option_id
children.description: The ID of the product option to update values for.

children.name: add
children.description: The IDs of the product option values to add, or new values to create.

children.name: remove
children.description: The IDs of the product option values to remove.
